Application Data.NAME: Smith Heating and Refrigeration Services, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Heating and Refrigeration Services, LLC specializes in residential and small commercial HVAC systems, providing installation, maintenance, and repair services. Our team consists of certified and licensed technicians who are committed to ongoing professional development and adherence to industry safety standards. We maintain a clean safety record and have implemented comprehensive employee training programs to ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements. Additionally, we offer emergency response services for heating and refrigeration needs, utilizing best practices in risk management to mitigate any potential hazards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, we experienced a service-related incident involving a minor refrigerant leak during routine maintenance at a residential property. The leak was promptly contained, and the affected area was sealed off to prevent any exposure. The cost of repairs and refrigerant replacement amounted to $1,200. The status of this incident is closed, with no further claims filed related to this event. All safety protocols were followed, and the incident has not affected our overall safety record.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the service yard, along with an on-site watchperson during after-hours operations to monitor access and ensure safety protocols are followed.
